scope: Exploratory same-observation fitter-plus-simple-calibration versus frozen learned margin/warning predictors; not promotion of unqualified fitter, original TRAIN designs only
physical_acquisition: Replay the same 48 physical schedules and initial conditions using unchanged temporal_probe.schedule/acquire; no new structural designs or speed sweeps. Original clean/iid1 features and gates must reproduce archived inputs. Cache raw waveforms for subsequent diagnostics.
noise_protocol: diagnostic_matrix.noises, SeedSequence([20261010,design_integer,replicate,profile_index]); first51 physical aggregate centered RMS reference, fixed absolute floor, rho=.8 correlated draw with realized per-channel RMS matched to white. clean/iid1 reproduce original noise. No noise-percent oracle input.
observation: Identical causal128-sample windows, stride64, original command-free/finite/unsaturated checks and original first64-to-next64 LS forecast skill >=.5 shared gate. No simulator poles, design identity, velocity, true margin, future waveform or commanded schedule in predictors.
fitter: Unchanged waveform-only single-mode stationary warm-start plus varying fitter, unchanged settings. Fit shared-gate windows, availability requires both optimizer success and interior bounds; no truth-based pole selection or residual threshold. Every failure retained.
calibration: Ridge degree1 and degree2 (PolynomialFeatures without bias), existing sum-squares convention/scaling and ALPHAS logspace(-6,6,25). Select degree/alpha by leave-one-design-out within the FOUR proper training designs, clean/iid1 only; fit final map on those observed rows. No validation/held/stress-noise fitting.
representation_control: Additional linear ridge on original174 LS analytical features; same four-design clean/iid1 LODO alpha selection and hold-last gap convention, no neural architecture. Distinguishes a richer modal representation from a nonlinear/recurrent readout advantage. Evaluated with the same common-fresh denominators and warning calibration.
learned: Frozen converged framewise, GRU and time-only checkpoints and original scaling; no neural retraining. Stress conditions use same feature extraction and inputs, including own original availability/age.
gaps: Fitter margin holds last valid estimate causally; prior to first fit, no point estimate (NaN). Explicit stale output/age and missing counts. No population-mean fallback and no safe declaration from absence. Learned missing-input outputs remain labeled extrapolation.
evaluation: Per noise/split/design: observed availability, fit failures, common-fresh MAE and paired design differences; available-output and common-all-output MAE; optimistic errors >.01/.03 on 0<m<.02, false stable on m<0, gap strata. Two previously inspected held designs are exploratory, not blind validation.

warning.calibration: Validation designs pooled clean/iid1 only; score -margin for fitter map/framewise/GRU/time-only and raw alpha_end for growth alarm. Fixed empirical strict-threshold rule with tie-safe <=budget; no stress retuning. This validation was previously used for neural checkpoint selection, so thresholds are exploratory, not independently calibrated guarantees.
warning.unknown: No fitter point before first observation; hold-last margin is stale. Raw-growth warning only on fresh valid fit. Unknown positive frames count as missed warnings; report abstention explicitly.
warning.temporal: Descriptive crossing lead/delay for cross schedules and false warning exposure; framewise empirical budgets are not episode/hour guarantees.

limitations: Shared original predictability gate can reject information a future fitter-specific gate might recover; this comparison tests readout value under common accepted observations, not optimum detector availability
Fitter did not pass previous all48 physical accuracy gate; comparison does not supersede or weaken that gate
Only8 original TRAIN designs, 2 held, one fixed trained neural initialization, paired noise draw per schedule; noise settings are sensitivities, not hardware specifications
